intended_behavior: Add a new method (e.g., to_dict) that returns a JSON-serializable dictionary representation of the Prompt instance. This dictionary should include at least "text" (the prompt text) and "has_image" (a boolean indicating if image_urls is present and non-empty). This method should enable safe serialization of Prompt objects.

Modify extract_learning to convert the Prompt instance to its JSON-serializable dictionary form by calling the new to_dict method before passing it as the "prompt" argument to the Learning constructor. This ensures that the Learning object contains only JSON-serializable data, thereby preventing serialization errors while preserving the existing functionality.
